# WEBDOGS Guides

> Shared knowledge from the WEBDOGS team — step-by-step setup guides,
> self-contained and safe to follow exactly as written. Each link below
> is the guide as plain Markdown (the HTML version lives at the same
> path without the /<name>.md suffix).

## Guides

- [Create a Google Maps API Key](https://guides.webdogs.com/google-maps-api-key/google-maps-api-key.md): For website owners. About 15 minutes; free for typical traffic. (last verified 2026-06-11)
- [Set Up Google Workspace MX Records](https://guides.webdogs.com/workspace-mx-records/workspace-mx-records.md): The current single-record setup, plus the legacy five-record set. (last verified 2026-06-11)
- [Set Up SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for Google Workspace](https://guides.webdogs.com/spf-dkim-dmarc/spf-dkim-dmarc.md): Current record values and a staged DMARC rollout. About 30 minutes. (last verified 2026-06-11)
- [Set Up Private Voice Dictation on Your Mac](https://guides.webdogs.com/typewhisper/typewhisper.md): TypeWhisper on macOS. Free, fully on-device. About 10 minutes. (last verified 2026-06-10)
